title: Lemon Garlic Spaghetti
description: Ready in 20 minutes and perfect for busy weeknights!
directions: Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente. Save 1/2 cup of the pasta water.
Melt the butter in a large pan and cook the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the lemon zest, juice and pasta water, then toss in the spaghetti.
Stir in the Parmesan and parsley. Season with salt and pepper.
